scope: Preserve held PS/2 Ctrl/Alt/AltGr until real release or confirmed input resync.

implementation.removed: The 750-ms clear_stale heuristic, modifier timestamp/key-seen bookkeeping and timer reads tied to ordinary console polling.
implementation.confirmed_reset: Synchronize the text/status modifier bits and E0 prefix when the existing physical transition queue publishes Reset. Drop the same triggering scan that the physical queue dropped. init/disable also clear that projection.
implementation.ownership: Existing short IRQ-safe metadata owner, physical/codepoint queues, Runtime sequence publication and wake ordering retained. No new input owner or timeout.
implementation.abi: Public snapshot layout and legacy stale-reset counter retained; the timed-reset count stays zero. No public API/ABI change.
implementation.diagnostic: Existing explicit CHECK INPUT /MODIFIERS checks real QMP-emulated PS/2 Ctrl/Alt/AltGr holds across750ms, real releases and one bounded physical-queue resync. Physical snapshots and console codepoints must agree; layout is restored.

scoped_guest.repeat_scope: Only RESYNC after correcting diagnostic Enter expectation13 to existing decoder LF10; kernel and green hold phases unchanged, not repeated.

spectra.resync_expectation: Existing Enter LF10; optional only-resync repeat.

held_modifiers.scope: Three held-modifier/release phases only; resync later failed due Enter10 vs13 in the diagnostic. No kernel change for the correction.

resync_harness_correction.observed: All three hold/release phases passed. The resync fill ended with the existing decoder LF10, while the new diagnostic waited for CR13 and timed out.
resync_harness_correction.fix: Correct Enter expectation to10; add explicit /MODIFIERS /RESYNC and matching host -ResyncOnly to repeat only the failed case.

validation.comparison_limit: One final STANDARD per subversion; score changes are descriptive single-run observations.

comparison_previous_release.observation: Filesystem index104.835295 is above the fixed reference after the preceding lower result; memory remains high. Input changes do not establish a filesystem optimization. These are descriptive single-run observations, with repeatability and cause unproven; no extra benchmark or method change.

performance_assessment: The normal input/polling and confirmed-resync paths change. Exactly one final Suite-2 STANDARD on SMP4 is required.
limits: Run only from the standalone boot terminal without a competing desktop physical-queue consumer.
The bounded input mode requires a prepared host/operator sequence; it never injects kernel events or silently selects an ordinary passive query.
Left/right Shift and Ctrl overlap behavior is intentionally left to the separately planned0.84.9.
The scoped evidence will cover emulated PS/2, not physical keyboard hardware or a Windows host.
Full benchmark exports/raw samples stay outside Git.
